summary: MZ73 job 1191 completed successfully; its nine-image GPU ML-CI-NEB path was returned and accepted only for VASP label selection, and hash-bound image 02-06 static force-label inputs were prepared but not submitted.

payload.objective: Validate the returned nine-image AQCat25 path for Fe(110) C* + H* -> CH* + * and use it to prepare a reviewable VASP force-label batch for active-learning calibration.
current_evidence: MZ73 producer job 1191 exited successfully after converged ordinary ML-NEB and ML-CI-NEB stages; the returned candidate manifest contains nine hash-bound images.
Canonical manifest validation passed and the local geometry diagnosis passed for atom order, cell, bottom-18 fixed mask, periodic branch, contacts, and path continuity.
C-H decreases monotonically from 2.9728 A to 1.1063 A and the single predicted internal energy maximum is image 04 at C-H=1.4364 A.
The path is accepted only as the source for VASP force-label selection; it is not a DFT barrier and no Dimer-parent manifest has been finalized.
Image 02-06 exact-structure static force-label bundles were generated with individual hashes and all five diagnostic-static preflights passed.

The generated label INCAR uses SIGMA=0.10 eV from the approved active-learning builder, while the reaction compatibility and final-energy branch use SIGMA=0.20 eV; this requires an explicit method decision before VASP execution.
No POTCAR was copied and no VASP execution gate or submission authorization exists.
payload.one_executable_step: Review the prepared image 02-06 batch and resolve whether active-learning force labels remain on the configured non-reportable SIGMA=0.10 static branch or must be rebuilt on the reaction-compatible SIGMA=0.20 branch before any VASP authorization.
payload.submission_boundary: The user authorized return, formal path review, and local preparation of image 02-06 VASP force-label inputs only. No VASP upload, POTCAR copy, force-label submission, DIMER, frequency, restart, resubmission, or additional GPU job is authorized.
done_when: The returned job-1191 manifest and all nine structures are locally collected and hash validated.
The nine-image path passes work-side structural and elementary-step review for VASP label selection.
A hash-bound image 02-06 force-label batch is prepared for user review without POTCAR or submission.
